THE PARITY MEASUREMENT. The cloud lambda's silver is QUARANTINED here (SILVER_ROOT="_cloudprobe/") while the laptop remains the producer of record. These artifacts are the measurement, not a by-product -- moving or corrupting them costs the window, not just a number.

parity_protocol.status: OPEN -- day 1 (07-13) EXACT: 0 mismatches, sum(net_assets) delta $0.00

pipeline.parity_protocol: Gate: `python .tools/etfs-parity-check.py` -- reads BOTH sides from S3, so neither is a producer self-report. Refuses a cutover verdict below 3 trading days and exits non-zero. It refuses its own best day, by design. CUTOVER ORDER, NON-NEGOTIABLE: (1) >=3 trading days of value-by-value parity ON THE ARTIFACT -- never on rc=0; (2) flip local.silver_root to ""; (3) VERIFY the cloud writes LIVE silver (the LAMBDA's stamp, not the laptop's 18:00 one); (4) ONLY THEN disable the Windows task. Two producers briefly is SAFE (the history upsert is idempotent on (run_date,key)); A GAP IS NOT -- it is a hole in 27% of fee-paying AUM.

pipeline.opal_assets_c4: Retargets the BRONZE landing to the opal-data-assets monolith. Bronze resolves its bucket SEPARATELY from silver (BRONZE_BUCKET vs ETFS_BUCKET): SILVER_ROOT quarantines the silver PREFIX, never the BUCKET, so a naive retarget would have carried the _cloudprobe/ parity artifacts into the monolith mid-window. Landing map (PRD v1.3.6 ruling 15 -- the bronze scope is the VENDOR'S DELIVERY scope; per-fund partitioning happens at SILVER, never at ingest): trueshares/{TICKER}/bronze/netassets/{YYYYMMDD}/ pathfinder/filepoint/bronze/{holdings|dailynav}/{YYYYMMDD}/ (one file, BOTH funds, whole+raw) msn/{TICKER}/bronze/netassets/{YYYYMMDD}/ Commits: d69efaad2 (code), 9989a27a3 (TF). The C1 flip is TWO locals: bronze_bucket -> "opal-data-assets", bronze_grammar -> "monolith".
